source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 (schools) + Recovered Design Notes (module names)

effects.note: engine: 25 soul damage x soul multiplier, will_power vs defense

schools.name: Buff
schools.text: One ally: +2 to hit, or +2 Defense, or heal 30 x Healing multiplier; 2 rounds.

schools.name: Control
schools.text: Push or pull 3 tiles, or Pinned, or Slowed (Body save).

schools.name: Status
schools.text: Fear, Shaken, Confused, or a Left or Right Brain Debuff (Heart or Brain save).

cost_rules: (school base + modules + 20 if second school) x band multiplier x (1 - 5% x (insight-1))
notes: School numbers are from the spec. All module costs and effects are new and provisional; the 2020 notes named the modules with no costs.

items.name: Move
items.text: The spell travels: range 8 tiles (base reach is 4 tiles + Soul range bonus).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Duplicate
items.text: A second copy hits a second target within 3 tiles of the first.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Bounce
items.text: After hitting, jumps once to another target within 3 tiles at half effect.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Homing
items.text: Ignores half cover and gets +2 to hit.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Swift
items.text: Cast AP −1 (minimum 1; AP ceiling still applies).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Rain
items.text: Hits every tile in radius 2; damage x0.6.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Teleport
items.text: The spell appears anywhere you can see, no line of sight needed past the first tile, or moves the target (ally) up to 4 tiles.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Mastery
items.text: Effect x1.25 for a design you have cast at least 10 times (the engine counts casts).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Ether
items.text: The spell passes through walls and solid cover.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Right
items.text: Shapes the spell for the heart: Status spells use the Heart save.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Left
items.text: Shapes the spell for the brain: Status spells use the Brain save.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Time
items.text: Duration +2 rounds; damage spells deal half again next turn.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Inverse
items.text: Flips the effect: damage becomes a shield of the same size on an ally; a debuff becomes its opposite (narrator rules the opposite).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Size
items.text: Area +1 radius, or a single-target spell becomes radius 1.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Random
items.text: Cost −10, but the engine rolls the target among all creatures within range.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Impact
items.text: Default: the effect happens when the spell lands.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: At Once
items.text: The effect lands on cast with no attack roll; damage spells deal half.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Expire
items.text: The effect lands when the spell's duration runs out (a delayed blast).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Periodic
items.text: The effect repeats at the start of each of the target's turns for 2 rounds, at half strength.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Proximity
items.text: Placed on a tile; fires on the first enemy to enter within 1 tile, up to 3 rounds.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new
